protocol.span_units: vLLM v0.23.0 emits gen_ai.latency.* in seconds; x1000 to ms

core_pinning.why: ADR 0009: the collector and Phoenix run on a separate core set from the serving process, so the cost measured is the engine's

env.tracing_path: vLLM --otlp-traces-endpoint → otel collector (grpc 4317) → Phoenix (grpc 4317) + scratch spans.json (the pairing source)
env.arm_order_confound: one GPU forces sequential arms; the base arm ran first, so time-of-day drift lands in the arms' difference

trace_example.note: one matched pair, committed as the L4 example trace (ADR 0009); the raw span is vLLM's llm_request export

conditions.b: l4-otel base arm (this run, same day, ran first)

findings.reading: tracing<base at the instrument's resolution — NOT claimable (|effect| 0.367 < bar 5.3 ms); recorded, flips between fresh runs by design
findings.claimability_rule: ADR 0007: a finding is claimable only if |effect| >= 10x the cell's committed instrument p99 error (results/instrument/validation.json). Every verdict is still computed by the mechanical ADR 0008 sign rule; sub-bar verdicts sit at the instrument's resolution, flip between fresh runs by design (2026-10-10: L1 c=1 TTFT, 0.012 ms) and are recorded as information, never gated. L4: the bar applies to the overhead finding (tracing vs base latency medians) and to the gap finding (client vs span TTFT medians); throughput has no bar (the instrument errors are latency ms) and is information only. A gap cell with coverage < 98% is invalid — flagged, never gated.

findings_headline.reading: Finding 1: tracing arm vs base arm, same day, base first. Finding 2: client TTFT vs engine span TTFT, paired by trace id. Claimability per ADR 0007 (|effect| >= 10x instrument p99 error); 'indistinguishable' means not separated by the runs, never 'equal'; throughput is information only (no bar).
